title.en: The source of a typed project is typed

summary.en: A hand-written JavaScript file in a TypeScript project's source is not type-checked; its source of truth should be a typed file.

en: A JavaScript file was about to live in a typed project.
I am keeping the source typed, so the tools can catch mistakes.
fr: Un fichier JavaScript allait vivre dans un projet typé.
Je garde la source typée, pour que les outils repèrent les erreurs.

reason.en: A hand-written JavaScript file was found in a TypeScript project's source, where it is not type-checked and its source of truth should be a typed file. Write it as a typed file so the compiler checks it, or, if it is generated, keep it under the compiler's output directory. A project that turns on allowJs is left alone, and so are compiled output and configuration files.
